title.label: Basic audio playback is a challenge for this app…

content.label:
NEW ISSUES MARCH 2021:
The play next feature does not work. Downloading/Streaming options cause all sorts of issues, especially while attempting to AirPlay to a HomePod. Using this app with CarPlay is also rather finicky. The app has some of the worst podcast discovery/search options I’ve seen. I’m ready to migrate to a different app.

December 2025:
I stopped using this app from 2021 until early 2025. I decided to give it another go after the “big rewrite” and see if things had improved. Sorry to say but there’s so many little annoyances in this app that it’s unusable for me. CarPlay still isn’t consistent. Most of my podcast listening is done in the car, and when random episodes (downloaded or “streamed”) stop playing for no reason and the app crashes, it’s beyond frustrating. I’ve had a couple of new iPhones over the years, so it’s not out of date hardware. 

Yesterday, I received a phone call while listening to ATP.fm (the irony) and after the call ended, Overcast simply never resumed playback and my now playing widget showed that I was listening to nothing. I’ve witnessed this behavior a lot frequently where if the podcast is paused, for a min or longer, the now playing widget shows nothing playing and I have to open the app and resume playback. It’s like the process is being backgrounded and killed. 

This is a podcast app, it should play audio seamlessly and effortlessly like Apple Music, the Apple Podcast app, and even backgrounded YouTube. It doesn’t. 

The developer whines on his podcasts about how bad the negative reviews make him feel. I too develop software used by random people across the globe. I take the feedback and improve the product I work on. I don’t whine to my podcast audience about how negative feedback hurts my feelings, I fix the issues.
The title says it all. This has replaced my TV.

I am begging you to please fix the issue where if a podcast isn’t fully downloaded yet while starting to play it randomly jumps to the next podcast.  It is so frustrating.  Otherwise this is a good app.  Also add a feature in car play to delete episodes and a better way to sort episodes in car play.

title.label: The Best Podcast Player, Hands Down

content.label:
I haven’t tried many podcast apps. I don’t need to because Overcast is simply in a league of its own. This app has completely transformed how I listen to podcasts.

My favorite feature is Smart Speed. It intelligently shortens silences without making anyone sound like a chipmunk, and I've saved literally days of listening time over the years. Voice Boost ensures I can hear every episode clearly whether I'm on a noisy subway or out for a run.

The new interface upgrade is clean and intuitive. Everything is exactly where you'd expect it to be. Creating playlists is effortless (I love the toggles for my playlists in one place), the queue management is smooth, and syncing across devices is seamless. I love that I can start listening on my iPhone and pick up right where I left off on my iPad or Mac.

Marco has clearly put so much care into every detail of this app. It's reliable, fast, and just works beautifully. The fact that all these premium features are available for free, is incredibly generous.

If you listen to podcasts, stop reading this and download Overcast now. You won't regret it!

The app downloads podcast as “You might like”. I delete the same suggested one every time. A great app would figure out I don’t want that podcast and stop suggesting it. How can it be a good podcast if the app tries to bully you into listening to it. It has to be about money. You can find a better free podcast app.
